description: Workflow Health previews and applies deterministic workflow asset repairs without silently changing behavior.

requirements.title: Preview and Apply Mechanical Fixes
requirements.description: Workflow Health must preview and apply only deterministic structural fixes, including registry rebuilds, metadata normalization, missing docs stubs, legacy reset normalization, and unambiguous requirement-label repairs; behavioral workflow edits must remain preview-only or manual.

validation.notes: Fix engine tests run preview/apply on temporary fixtures and assert exact diffs, idempotence, and refusal to rewrite ambiguous workflow behavior.

title: Deterministic remediation
